source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of balancing parentheses (PDF 99).

items: Khulne wali qausain ka hisab rakhne ke liye stack istemal karein.
Khulne wali qaus par push karein.
Band hone wali qaus par stack ka top pop karein.
Aakhir mein stack khali ho to qausain mutawazin hain.
Stack khali na ho, ya khali stack se pop ki koshish ho, to mutawazin nahi.

blocks.text: Misal: (3 + 4) * (5 - 2) mutawazin hai: har ( ka mel khata ) hai.

blocks.prompt: Stack qausain ka tawazun kaise jaanchta hai (short question 4)? (a + b)) * (c jaanchein.
blocks.explanation: Har ( push aur har ) par pop; expression tabhi mutawazin hai jab koi pop khali stack se na takraye aur aakhir mein stack khali ho. (a + b)) * (c mein doosri ) khali stack se pop ki koshish karti hai, to mutawazin nahi.

items: '(' push, ')' par pop; mutawazin agar kabhi khali stack se pop na ho aur aakhir mein khali ho.
